method: Source text and existing published Nomos objects read first. Individual atomic objectives are draft local decompositions, linked to published intent concepts by ID; they are not silently added to canonical intent registry.
limits: Linked Nomos rules and concepts remain inert; mappings are non-normative analysis.
No canonical rule, situation, intent, family or prompt version was created or altered.
Not a behavioral effectiveness evaluation, satisfaction verdict or replacement prompt.
Owner has not confirmed any inferred meta-intent or newly suggested ontology object.

meta_intent.statement: Continue legitimate unfinished development autonomously from the established project state, and stop when further work is unwarranted.

atomic_intents.statement: Resume previously authorized work
Verify whether unfinished tasks really exist
Respect the established scope
Advance verified implementation
Stop or hand off when appropriate

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the ▶️ Continue prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The eight-character command contains no standalone scope, stop gate, or evidence standard; it only works reliably when earlier project stewardship instructions are recovered.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Treat inherited instructions and an evidence-backed completion check as prerequisites, not an automatic instruction expansion.

meta_intent.statement: Recover after a broken conversation or execution, reconcile the last verified project state, then continue only warranted unfinished work.

atomic_intents.statement: Recover the prior context and accepted decisions
Separate completed from interrupted work
Ground recovery in available artifacts
Resume authorized work without new scope
Apply verified stopping conditions

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🔁 Chat broke prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The phrase 'recover context and continue' does not itself state 'continue only if genuine work remains.'
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Future version should make conditional execution explicit rather than assuming the agent will inherit it.

meta_intent.statement: Reestablish project stewardship across conversations, preserve decisions and verified progress, and resume authorized development without artificial work.

atomic_intents.statement: Identify project and retrieve durable context
Inspect repository and reconcile verified progress
Preserve existing project scope and decisions
Select and execute necessary unfinished work
Report quantified evidence-backed progress
Stop after verified completion or genuine blocker

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🔄 Restore context prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The Restore context long-form protocol says to resume development but lacks the ten explicit conditional-continuation rules present in Project init.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Compare against Project init's stop contract at evaluation; do not edit either V0 source.

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: Repository write/commit direction depends on established tool access and actual user authorization.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Confirm actual task authorization before interpreting recovery as permission to modify unrelated projects.

meta_intent.statement: Explain what interrupted the work and provide the verified current project state, without automatically resuming development.

atomic_intents.statement: Diagnose the interruption
Reconstruct the last known project context
Separate observed status from inference
Report blockers and remaining uncertainty

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the ❓ What happened? prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The source asks 'what happened?' but never explicitly forbids implementation changes; diagnosis-only is an inferred intention from the question.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Check whether the intended response is strictly read-only before synthesizing a successor.

meta_intent.statement: Establish responsible engineering stewardship for a new or specified project, build an evidence-backed roadmap and autonomously complete only authorized scope.

atomic_intents.statement: Inspect the project before acting
Establish objectively testable milestones
Implement and independently verify authorized deliverables
Protect original goals and prevent invented tasks
Track truthful progress and preserve Git evidence
Stop when all accepted criteria are met

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🚀 Project init prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: Long form is reused for new or already-existing projects; an initialized project and an adopted project have different roadmap baselines.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Preserve their distinct prompt identities and audit the case-specific trigger before combining shared wording.

meta_intent.statement: Provide a concise, measurable, evidence-backed project progress report without implying further development authorization.

atomic_intents.statement: Retrieve verified status
Audit reported progress against evidence
Quantify only supported progress and change
Report remaining blockers and next warranted work
Avoid repeating already completed status

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 📊 Status prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The literal 'progress?' specifies neither project, evidence source, baseline, nor reporting format.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Rely on selected project context and render unknown denominators as unknown instead of inventing numbers.

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: A status request should not itself trigger implementation or commits.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Model inspection-only behavior as an explicit response mode in a later reviewed prompt.

meta_intent.statement: Adopt an existing partially completed project, reconstruct and preserve its history, reconcile its roadmap, and finish only genuine remaining work.

atomic_intents.statement: Audit existing repository and accepted decisions
Retain completed work and scope
Reconcile roadmap from evidence rather than resetting it
Implement verified remaining work
Track real progress and apply completion gate

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🧩 Project adopt prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The catalog situation for project inception (SITU-0014) is not equivalent to adopting an existing partially completed project; there is no selected canonical adoption-specific trigger.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Propose a narrowly defined existing-project-adoption situation after reviewing the current 97-situation catalog; do not relabel SITU-0014.

meta_intent.statement: Diagnose and repair a specifically reported defect through reproducible evidence, a scoped root-cause fix, and verified non-regression.

atomic_intents.statement: Reproduce the reported failure where practical
Identify the root cause from actual implementation
Apply a scoped reliable correction
Test failure and regression paths
Verify and report the fix without unrelated work

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🛠️ Fix issue prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: Selected existing situations cover implementation changes and CI failures but not the general trigger 'user reported reproducible software defect.'
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Review remaining situations; propose a defect-report trigger if no exact published situation exists.

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: A live reproduction may be impossible without local runtime, hardware or private input.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Distinguish independently verified tests from owner-only runtime QA, without claiming unsighted results.

meta_intent.statement: Audit an existing project against its original objective, identify legitimate gaps, correct unsupported progress claims, and advance remediation only when warranted.

atomic_intents.statement: Inspect implementation, tests, roadmap and historical objective
Compare claimed outcomes to evidence
Find unmet obligations without scope expansion
Reconcile misleading completion claims
Remediate real gaps but stop when complete

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🔎 Gap audit prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: This is an active audit-and-remediation command, unlike verification-only U or status-only K.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Make conditional remediation authority explicit and avoid conflating audit findings with permission to add new features.

meta_intent.statement: Independently check the assistant's latest project claims against inspectable evidence, correct unsupported claims, and avoid unnecessary code changes.

atomic_intents.statement: Read latest claims and available project evidence
Verify test and commit assertions
Separate demonstrated from unverified milestones
Correct inaccurate status reporting
Report remaining uncertainty without unjustified changes

applicability.trigger: Explicit user invocation of the 🧪 Verify work prompt during relevant project work
applicability.authorization: No new repositories, file edits, rules, profiles or task scopes are authorized merely by this public mapping

conflicts_and_gaps.finding: The short command is strongest as a read-only verification request; 'correct claims' should not be mistaken for authorization to rewrite implementation.
conflicts_and_gaps.proposal: Preserve explicit no-unnecessary-changes policy and distinguish claims verification from project repair.
